ShortDescription.Value: Bind a key to any Info View overlay.

Publish.LongDescription:
Adds a rebindable hotkey for every Info View overlay (Natural Resources, Healthcare & Deathcare, Happiness, and so on).
* Options > Info View Hotkeys > Info views: set a key next to any base-game info view. * Other (DLC & mods) tab: extra slots for info views added by DLC or other mods. * Pressing the key of the info view that's already open closes it (can be turned off). * Optional "Close info view" key. * Uses the game's own key binding system, so conflicts show up in the options screen like any other binding.
